mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 8.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2010-2012.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction that lowers corporate revenue expectations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in >60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2010-2012.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing output below 95.0 (INDPRO) signals supply chain bottlenecks that increase corporate input costs and reduce profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2010-2012.

mechanism_narrative: A rising CPI (CPIAUCSL) indicates inflationary pressures that prompt monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and reducing valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2010-2012.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls exceeding 130,000 (PAYEMS) signal strong labor market growth that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in >60% of instances when PAYEMS > 130000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2010-2012.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust economic growth that elevates corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in >60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST increase, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2010-2012.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing output above 100.0 (INDPRO) signals improved supply chain efficiency that reduces costs and increases corporate profits, causing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in >60% of instances when INDPRO > 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2010-2012.
